responsibilities.name: define input values and action bindings
currentOwners: crates/engine_input/src/key_code.rs::KeyCode and its winit conversion define the supported keyboard value surface
crates/engine_input/src/mouse_button.rs::MouseButton and its winit conversion define the supported mouse-button value surface

responsibilities.name: transport and apply keyboard input
currentOwners: crates/engine_input/src/keyboard/state.rs::InputState owns pressed, just-pressed, and just-released keyboard state and action queries
crates/engine_input/src/keyboard/system.rs::input_system drains keyboard events and advances frame state

responsibilities.name: transport and apply mouse input
currentOwners: crates/engine_input/src/mouse/buffer.rs::MouseInputEvent transports button, movement, and scroll events
crates/engine_input/src/mouse/state.rs::MouseState owns button, screen/world position, and scroll state
crates/engine_input/src/mouse/system.rs::mouse_input_system drains mouse events and scroll_clear_system clears frame scroll

findings.scope: The scan reports 20 errors and 108 warnings across 21 files; 118 findings are in tests or line-length/comment rules, while the remaining production findings are necessary public mappings or small input-system heuristics.
findings.reason: The production definitions already have one owner per responsibility. Splitting the large behavior tests would be organizational churn, genericizing keyboard and mouse state would erase domain-specific fields, and changing public mappings or event handling would widen API or runtime risk without a measured responsibility defect.
